description: A Florida vacation rental's guest guidebook, from the link or code on the house's fridge card (headedin.com/stay/<code>): the host's welcome, house notes (Wi-Fi name, check-out, parking, trash, beach gear), house rules, the host's own local picks with map links, the listing link, and the house's approximate spot for nearby beach, red tide and event info. Only pages the host has published, and only by their own link: it can't search or list rentals. No door codes or passwords are ever on a page. Use it when a guest shares their rental's guidebook link or asks what their host said about the house.

page.description: The guidebook link, e.g. https://headedin.com/stay/pelican-house-demo, or just the code after /stay/

name: stay_guidebook
title: Rental guest guidebook
